disposition: UX agent startup is deferred by owner direction; this accounting covers the other work.

phases.activity: Inspect existing model and update contracts
Author and run model proposal update
Prepare validation/persistence wrapper; validate and save
Read handoff contracts and prepare reusable UX inputs

method: Consecutive wall-clock activity windows ending at saved command receipts or dispatch. These include generation, reasoning, tools and waiting; they are not exclusive measurements of semantic design work. Initial boundary has second precision.
overlap: Parent diagnostic work continued during the 70.422-second UX startup window. That elapsed window is not added a second time.
excluded: Conversation pauses, earlier instruction-reader development, and report/diagnostic work after interruption are outside the latest pre-dispatch total.
